title: Bay State Gas Company files for approval by the Department of Telecommunications and Energy a Firm Transportation Service Contract with the Middleborough Gas & Electric Department.
petitioner: Bay State Gas Company d/b/a Columbia Gas
filings: Bay state Gas Company's response to the Department of Telecommunications & Energy's second set of information requests. By: Joseph A. Ferro, Director, Revenue Development, Bay State Gas Company. (GC 00-12)

The Department APPROVES the proposed Agreement. Commissioners participating were: James Connelly, Chairman; Commissioners W. Robert Keating, Dierde K. Manning, Paul B. Vasington, and Eugene J. Sullivan, Jr. (GC 00-12)

Letter of Middleborough Gas & Electric Department requesting the Department of Telecommunications & Energy to approve this agreement as expeditiously as possible. By: James L. Collins, Energy Analyst, Middleborough Gas & Electric Department. (GC 00-12)
Bay State Gas Company files responses to the Department's First Set of Information Requests. By: Joseph A. Ferro, Director, Revenue Development, Bay State Gas Company. (GC 00-12)

Letter of Joseph A. Ferro, Director, Revenue Development, Bay State Gas Company that agrees to voluntarily extend the review period and effective date of the proposed contract until April 18, 200, or receipt of Department approval, whichever is sooner. (GC 00-12)
